S076-03.notes: Plain plural object of 'for'; no possession. Williams first Black AIA member 1923, ~3,000 buildings, celebrity homes: accurate.

S076-04.notes: Past perfect for action before past event 'helped start'. Huerta taught elementary school in Stockton before co-founding NFWA in 1962; quote paraphrase accurate.
